title: CobbleVersus
description: Embark on a Pokemon adventure alongside your friends!
body:
#  Presentation
Welcome to CobbleVersus, a Cobblemon modpack that intends to deliver a relaxing and enjoyable experience.

At its core, the modpack is intended to provide the highest-quality overall feel, with smooth gameplay and carefully chosen features that work well together.

Besides the Cobblemon addons there are a variety of mods covering optimization and visual aesthetics.

You can play multiplayer without the need of a server, that being made possible by Essential Mod.

Music is made by Zame, you can find his pages in the Music section below and every song used in the music credits file.

Warning! The modpack is relatively big, so you will need to allocate minimum 6144mb RAM for it to run normally (even more if you want to run smoothly with 0 freeezes)





 # Content


- Every single Pokémon
- Z-A Megas
- Awesome Poké-Themed Music
- Legend/Mythical Structures
- Gigantamaxes, Terastallizations, Z-Moves, Primal/Origin Forms
- Ultra Beasts
- Stadiums (N, Cynthia, Steven, Lance)
- Paradox Pokémon (including Miraidon and Koraidon)
- More alive nature/terrain
- Enhanced Survival Mode (hydratation, temperature)
- No level cap, you can fight trainers at whatever level




# Absences

No gym-like progression yet

No breeding yet

No battle music yet





# Tips

Crouch + Left Click near water to drink

Press F6 to enable/disable third-person model in first-person

If experiencing lag, change or disable the shader (Settings > Graphics > Shaderpacks)





# Important Notes

If you wish to report any bugs or have any suggestions please join the Discord server
